learnings.description: What was learned from this prototype

question.description: What building this is meant to settle. Known before construction, which is why it is required while `learnings` is not.

mechanism: An early sample, model, or release of a product built to test a concept or process or to act as a thing to be learned from. It is generally low-fidelity and disposable.
invariants: Declares the question it was built to answer.
Records the answer, or that none was reached, before it is retired or promoted.
failure_modes: Promoted by inertia: kept because it works well enough, so choices made for cheap learning become load-bearing.
Built without a question: produces an artifact and no answer, which is the waste case rather than a cheap experiment.
